answer: Each agent locks 120 credits in a vault releasing 15 per epoch, only while its behavioral fingerprint holds. Layered like shale, each epoch adds a stratum of call mix, timing, and cadence matching earlier ones. Zephyr checks come unannounced; machine timing fails and freezes the vault. 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 locked plus 48,000 fees, vs a 40,000 pool. Rented behavior fails: bought layers never match. Honest agents pay 120 once and unlock all.
